text.en: Owner and groomer Esra receives heartfelt praise from local dog parents in Newington Green. Reviewers highlight her kindness, helpful guidance for first-time dog owners, and flexible scheduling, noting that her genuine love for animals creates an exceptionally reassuring and pleasant grooming experience.

Owners of senior dogs and nervous, anxious rescues report that their pets happily trot into the salon without hesitation. Clients value the calm, uncrowded setting where elderly dogs receive unhurried care and gentle breaks, returning home relaxed, settled, and completely stress-free.

Reviewers frequently describe the grooming results as flawless, noting that their dogs leave looking like canine superstars. Clients praise the intricate face shaping, neat coat scissoring, and refreshing hygiene treatments that keep curly and double-coated breeds looking their absolute best.

q.en: Can anxious or senior dogs be groomed here?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize that Esra accommodates nervous rescues and elderly dogs with patient pacing in a tranquil setting.
The parlour is located on Green Lanes in Newington Green, Islington, providing grooming and small daycare services.
Yes, packages include full body scissoring, baths with fluff drying, undercoat de-shedding, and introductory puppy sessions.
